## Performance analysis — cadence-lane-2

I verified this against the live tree rather than trusting cached results — this exact audit was run 3 times already today (07-18, 07-19 morning, 07-19 full-sweep), and `git log` shows 7 perf commits landed *this session* fixing nearly everything found. Below is the current, ground-truth state.

### Already shipped (committed, verified live)

| Area | Commit | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| N+1 cron probes | `4ab99344` | `resume-runs.ts` batched ~200 sequential/min queries into `.in("mission_id", ids)` |
| N+1 writes | `c1f99031` | `eval-runner.server.ts` + `lineage.functions.ts` batch inserts |
| Redundant computation | `fffa1b3d` | `CalendarPanel.tsx` — `useMemo` around filter/sort/groupBy |
| Redundant computation | `1e0dc3b6` | `ModelSwitcher.tsx` — hoisted static grouping to module scope |
| Memory leak | `1e0dc3b6` | `AmbientChip.tsx` — unmount cancellation guard on geolocation chain |
| N+1 queries | `531e03d2` | `capabilities.functions.ts` — batch-loaded per-agent metadata |
| Caching | `c553d4c0` | `runtime.server.ts` — BYOK key resolution cached across retries |
| N+1/leaks | `5b0be19e` | `ApprovalsPanel.tsx` abort wiring + batched waiting-approvals query |

### In-flight right now (uncommitted, code-verified complete and correct)

Your working tree has 4 more files mid-fix. I read every diff — they're done, not half-finished:

**1. N+1 sequential AI calls** — `src/lib/ai/eval-runner.server.ts:157-226`
Was: `for (const c of cases) { await callModel(...subject); await callModel(...judge); }` — fully serial.
Now: bounded-concurrency fan-out.
```ts
const limit = pLimit(4);
const caseResults = await Promise.all(
  cases.map((c) => limit(async () => { /* subject + judge calls */ })),
);
```
~4x wall-clock speedup on eval suites, plus the earlier batch-insert is preserved.

**2. N+1 writes** — `src/lib/ai/assumption-watch.server.ts:131-190`
Was: one `update` + one conditional `insert` per assumption, in a loop.
Now: judgments run
